_note: Shape of <marketplace-clone>/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json across the 4 local marketplaces. Claude Code 2.1.220. This is the file the fallback resolver reads for the 'version in the marketplace entry' rule of §3.3 and for source-type dispatch in T2.2.

topLevelKeys.name: string — REQUIRED, present in all 4
topLevelKeys.owner: object — { name, email? }, present in all 4
topLevelKeys.metadata: object — { description?, version? }, present in 3/4. metadata.version is a MARKETPLACE-level version, distinct from any plugin version.
topLevelKeys.renames: object — Record<oldName,newName>, present ONLY in claude-plugins-official. Undocumented. ccatlas must resolve renames or it will report a renamed plugin as removed-and-added.

pluginEntryKeys.name: string — REQUIRED
pluginEntryKeys.version: string — OPTIONAL and RARE. 16 of 281 entries across all 4 marketplaces declare it.
pluginEntryKeys.lspServers: present on the *-lsp entries; relevant to T1.14 LSP extension collisions

sourceTypes._note: Source is either a bare string (relative path within the marketplace repo) or an object with a discriminating `source` field.

string_relative._note: Resolved against the marketplace clone root.

object_url_with_pin._note: LOAD-BEARING FOR T2.4. The marketplace entry can pin a commit SHA via source.sha. This is a second, independent pinning mechanism that §3.3 does not mention — separate from `version` in plugin.json and from `version` in the marketplace entry. A marketplace that pins source.sha and never bumps it is stale-pinned regardless of what plugin.json says.

git_subdir._note: 79 entries in claude-plugins-official; shape not fully enumerated here.

claude-plugins-official._cloneNote: NOT a git checkout. Carries a .gcs-sha file (single 40-char SHA) instead — this marketplace is distributed as a GCS tarball. See FINDINGS.md; this breaks T2.2's installLocation-git-HEAD fallback for the largest marketplace.

_the14VersionedEntriesInOfficial._note: All are relative-source (./plugins/<name>). 13 of 14 are LSP shims at a flat 1.0.0; the 14th is security-guidance at 2.0.6. This is the population T2.5 must cross-check against cached plugin.json files.
